headlines.title: US midwest premium futures weaken (AL Circle, 21-November): the first-month Midwest premium contract closed at $2,388.81/t on 17-November with third-month at $2,065/t, a steep backwardation pointing to a lower duty-paid premium ahead; the spot Midwest premium was $1.12/lb on 4-November, down from a record $1.19/lb in late May. US ubc scrap fell 0.66% to $2,635.63/t on 18-November.

Oklahoma smelter under environmental review (AL Circle, 21-November): the proposed up-to-750,000 t/yr Inola smelter, a joint project of EGA and Century Aluminum (Oklahoma Primary Aluminum), is under review by the Oklahoma deq; a Jacobs evaluation estimates 328 t/yr of fluoride releases and recommends independent off-site monitoring. No permit or construction timeline was reported.

US trade enforcement on aluminium foil (AL Circle, 21-November): a July US Commerce preliminary ruling could raise the duty on Korea Aluminium's US foil exports to 105.8% over alleged rerouting of Chinese-origin foil via South Korea - a reminder that anti-circumvention enforcement adds to the Section 232 tariff wall.

Higher aluminium costs squeeze automakers (AL Circle, 20-November): aluminium prices up about 26% are weighing on Hyundai and Kia's profitability per their quarterly reporting - cost pass-through pressure on downstream users.

AL Circle analysis (21-November): Guinea's 183 Mt bauxite output, China's push toward 46 Mt of aluminium and Indonesia's 2.77 bt bauxite reserves are reshaping the global raw-material and supply picture.

LME cancelled warrants fall 9% (AL Circle, 20-November): on 19-November opening stocks were 226,150 t (+2.63%), live warrants 205,975 t and cancelled warrants down 1,825 t to 18,450 t; cash offer $3,105/t, three-month offer $2,845/t, December-2027 offer $2,788/t; three-month Asian Reference Price $2,869.5/t; LME alumina (Platts) $398/t.

Dollar's fourth weekly gain; 50bp floated (Trading Economics, 20-November): the dollar index held near 103.84, up about 0.5% on the week; Governor Waller suggested a 50bp December hike could be considered; markets price 25bp in December and another in January. Brent about $92.6 on a third weekly decline.
Kazakhstan-EU aluminium trade and cbam (AL Circle, 20-November): Kazakhstan's aluminium exports to the EU reached 110,184 t as the EU carbon border mechanism adds compliance demands for exporters.

Emkay: supply crunch to persist till 2028 (AL Circle, 19-November): Emkay Global expects a global deficit of about 400 kt in both 2027 and 2028; LME stocks down 57% year to date to about 220 kt; LME alumina near $400/t lifting costs; even its bear case ($2,600/t, 1.5% demand growth, two Fed hikes by March 2027) shows only a marginal surplus. EGA restoring ~585 kt by Q1-2027; Alba and Qatalum (~567 kt) restarts less certain.

India opens anti-dumping probe on aluminium extrusions (AL Circle, 19-November): the dgtr initiated an investigation into extrusions from China, Malaysia, Vietnam and Thailand - about 90% of India's imports of the product - on a petition by nine domestic manufacturers; preliminary evidence reportedly shows dumping above de minimis. No duty rates or timelines stated.

EU cbam expansion eyes more aluminium products (AL Circle, 19-November): EU industrial emissions fell 3.3% as the bloc considers widening the carbon border mechanism to more downstream aluminium products.
